# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 31 Aug 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## HDB Resale Records Keep Falling

- **Bedok 5-room flat sells for $1.45M — a new district record** - A five-room flat at 153B Bedok South Road transacted at $1,450,000 ($1,192 psf) in August 2026, beating the previous record set at the very same block just three months prior. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/bedok-5-room-hdb-sold-record-1-45m-same-block-broke-record-3-months-ago/)

- **Bishan 4-room flat hits S$1.3M for the first time** - A 4-room resale flat in Bishan changed hands at S$1.3 million in August 2026, the first Bishan 4-room sale to reach that level, and also set a new town-wide psf record for the flat type at approximately S$1,271 psf. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/bishan-4-room-hdb-records-first-1-3m-natura-loft/)

- **Pasir Ris records its first million-dollar 5-room flat sale** - A 5-room DBSS flat at Block 530D Pasir Ris Drive 1 sold for S$1.15 million, marking the first time a 5-room flat in Pasir Ris has crossed the million-dollar mark. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/pasir-ris-first-million-dollar-5-room-hdb-sale/)

- **Tampines DBSS unit sets new record at $1.12M** - A five-room DBSS flat at 519B Tampines Central 8 sold for $1,120,000 ($963 psf) in August 2026, a new price record for the flat type at the Centrale 8 development. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/tampines-dbss-flat-sold-for-record-1-12m-why-buyers-paying-premium/)

## Condo Market: Resale and New Launches

- **Condo resale volumes picked up in July 2026, but prices dipped slightly** - More condo resale units changed hands in July 2026 compared to the prior month, though volume remained slightly below the same period last year and prices edged lower, while still sitting above their year-ago level. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/condo-resale-activity-rebounds-in-july-2026-as-prices-edge-lower/)

- **Prime home capital values forecast to grow up to 3.9% in H2 2026** - Singapore's prime residential rents rose 1.7% in H1 2026, ahead of the 1.1% global average, with Savills forecasting prime capital value growth of 2% to 3.9% for H2 2026 — among the strongest outlooks across 30 cities tracked. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/singapore-prime-home-prices-grew-0-4-first-half-2026-2-signs-point-stronger-second-half/)
